build_VFNetHead: build a VFNetHead instance with num_classes and in_channels for IoU-aware dense object detection
forward_VFNetHead: run the VFNetHead forward pass on FPN feature maps to get cls scores and bbox predictions
loss_by_feat_VFNetHead: compute the VFNetHead loss including classification, bbox, and refined bbox loss components
star_dcn_offset_VFNetHead: compute star-shaped deformable convolution offsets from predicted bbox distance offsets for feature extraction
get_atss_targets_VFNetHead: compute ATSS targets for multi-level points including labels, bbox targets, and weights
